analysis: Propranolol (opa) is a beta-blocker primarily used for hypertension and anxiety, and it is not commonly associated with depression as a side effect. In contrast, reserpine (opc) is known to cause depression due to its mechanism of depleting monoamines. Flupenthixol (opd) is an antipsychotic that can also lead to depressive symptoms.
